description: Offline memoryless complex AWGN, production 16-QAM Gray mapper and max-log demapper, LDPC engine and interleaving. No audio tested.
snr_definition: Es/N0 with E[|complex noise|^2]=N0; each real/imag variance N0/2
details: Production per-frame permutation, capacity D8 rotation, and whitening; independently random source bytes per frame. No outer Reed-Solomon, padding, markers, OFDM, pilots, equalization, estimation error, physical-end handling, audio clocks, or non-AWGN channel.
criterion: wrong_frames counts any post-LDPC source-byte mismatch to known source; no source integrity acceptance shortcut.
seed_generator: std::mt19937_64; normal_distribution<double>; source bytes from low8bits of each generator word.
command: /tmp/ldpc_qam16_margin RATE ESN0_DB CYCLES SEED (8 LDPC frames per cycle)
